for order in orders {
    let lines = db.lines_of_order(order.id)?;
findings.recommendation: Replace the per-order `db.lines_of_order(order.id)` call with one call to the existing batch method `db.lines_of_orders(&order_ids)` (api/src/db.rs:30-33, `WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`), then group the lines by `order_id` (e.g. a HashMap<i64, i64> of totals) and build the summaries in the order returned by `orders_of_customer`, keeping orders with no line at a total of 0. This turns 1 + N queries (up to 101 per customer page view, as the proposal says the endpoint runs on every customer page view) into 2, without changing the ordering, the results or the error behavior. Alternatively, sum `quantity * unit_price_cents` with `GROUP BY order_id` in SQL.
